name: Answering a request gets a small pleased face
case: Claude asks to run a command a minute into its turn, and half a minute later the person allows it. The moment the amber sign clears, Boop is pleased: a pleased, happy, calm or engaged face, no finish, since the turn goes on. When the turn finishes well two minutes later, that's a success.
